results.name: Alchemist Shelf with Potion Bottles
results.description:
A highly detailed alchemist shelf set, a narrow two-tier wooden shelf crowded with glass vessels of many shapes holding cloudy amber, violet, and murky green liquids, several sealed with cork and dripped wax. A brass mortar and pestle, a small set of hanging balance scales, a folded stack of stained parchment notes, and two bundles of dried herbs tied with twine complete the scene. This model was created with the help of AI-assisted 3D generation as part of a fantasy alchemy prop collection. Realistic hand-blown glass, tarnished brass, aged wood, and dried plant textures form physically-based materials on a clean-topology, game-ready asset perfect for wizard towers, apothecary shops, RPG alchemist labs, and fantasy interiors. Only the objects themselves are included, without any ground or surrounding environment.

results.name: Witch Staff Diorama - Magic Shop Find
results.description:
A fantasy witch staff diorama from the Wandering Note Fantasy world.

This model features a twisted wooden staff with a blue crystal, displayed beside an antique magic shop shelf filled with potion bottles, scrolls, old books, a cauldron, a crystal ball, and a wooden storage box.

This model is part of an evolving prop and story-world series within the Wandering Note Fantasy project.

Created using AI-assisted tools including Meshy, then refined with Blender for presentation.
Generated with Meshy under a private/commercial-use license.

You are free to use this model for personal and commercial projects under the license shown on this Sketchfab page.
Please credit: "Sam Naot / Wandering Note Fantasy".

Visit the Wandering Note Fantasy 3D gallery:

[https://wnf-3d.carrd.co](https://wnf-3d.carrd.co)

More characters, images, and videos will be added over time.
